name: TeamStarWolf - The Zero-Day Trade and Its Fallout
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 75 ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified record in case-studies/ZERO_DAY_MARKET_EVENTS.md supports for Operation Aurora (Elderwood, Hydraq), the Equation group, the Hacking Team leak, WannaCry, NotPetya, Bad Rabbit, Shamoon and the 2019 Baltimore RobbinHood attack, from the ATT&CK software and group pages the study opened and data/attack/. Each comment names the event and the study's source numbers. Scores: 100 an ATT&CK page ties the technique to an event in the study, 75 an ATT&CK software or group record related to the event but not dated to it, 40 an Inferred mapping.
